quiz.question: Who was appointed as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of NITI Aayog by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet in July 2026 for a period of two years?
quiz.explanation: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) approved the appointment of Anurag Jain, a 1989-batch IAS officer of the Madhya Pradesh cadre, as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of NITI Aayog in July 2026. He succeeds B.V.R. Subrahmanyam and is appointed for a period of two years. NITI Aayog, established on January 1, 2015, is chaired by the Prime Minister of India.

quiz.question: Which state-backed initiative was officially launched in Maharashtra in July 2026 to integrate local kaali-peeli and tourist taxis onto a unified digital hailing platform with standardized tariffs?
quiz.explanation: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis officially launched the 'Bharat Taxi' service in July 2026 under a state-backed public-private partnership (PPP) model. The initiative aims to onboard existing local kaali-peeli and tourist taxis, as well as new electric vehicles, onto a single platform. It includes point-to-point transit services into tier-2, tier-3, and semi-urban talukas with transparent, distance-locked tariffs.

quiz.question: Kargil Vijay Diwas is observed annually on July 26 to honor the bravery and sacrifice of soldiers who fought in the 1999 Kargil War. What was the code name of the Indian Air Force's supporting mission during this conflict?
quiz.explanation: Kargil Vijay Diwas is observed every year on July 26 to mark the success of 'Operation Vijay', where the Indian Armed Forces recaptured strategic peaks occupied by Pakistani intruders in the Kargil sector of Ladakh. The Indian Air Force supported the land operations through 'Operation Safed Sagar', utilizing its combat power to neutralize enemy targets. This joint military operation successfully concluded on July 26, 1999.

quiz.question: In July 2026, a high-level review meeting was held in Mumbai to strengthen Maharashtra's sports and youth development ecosystem. Who chaired this meeting?
quiz.explanation: Smt. Raksha Khadse, the Union Minister of State for Youth Affairs and Sports, chaired a high-level review meeting in Mumbai in July 2026 to strengthen Maharashtra's sports and youth development. The primary agenda focused on expanding Khelo India infrastructure and implementing the National Youth Services Framework (NYSF). The initiative utilizes a collaborative funding model between the Union Ministry and the Maharashtra State Sports Department.

quiz.question: In July 2026, the indigenous vehicle-mounted, multi-layered counter-swarm drone system named 'Bhargavastra' was demonstrated under the Make-II category. In which city of Maharashtra was this demonstration conducted?
quiz.explanation: Bhargavastra is an indigenous, vehicle-mounted, multi-layered Counter-Swarm Drone System developed by Solar Defence and Aerospace Ltd. (SDAL) for the Indian Army. It was demonstrated in Nagpur, Maharashtra on July 24, 2026, during a Make-II programme status review. The hard-kill system utilizes a dual-layer kill mechanism consisting of unguided micro-rockets and precision-guided micro-missiles to destroy drone swarms.

quiz.question: Under India's Private FM Radio Policy Phase-III, what minimum percentage of daily broadcast content is mandatory for every private broadcaster to deliver in the local language of the city?
quiz.explanation: The Government of India confirmed on July 24, 2026, that 386 private FM radio channels are currently operational in the country under the Phase-III policy. The policy mandates that every broadcaster must ensure at least 20% of its daily broadcast content is in the local language of the city to promote regional culture, traditions, and folk music. It also permits private broadcasters to access Prasar Bharati towers and sites for a faster rollout.

quiz.question: The 16th BRICS Health Ministers' Meeting held in Chandigarh in July 2026 announced the establishment of a BRICS Network of Centres of Excellence (CoEs) on Mental Wellness. Which Indian institution has been designated to coordinate this network?
quiz.explanation: The 16th BRICS Health Ministers' Meeting concluded in Chandigarh in July 2026 under India's BRICS Chairship. A key outcome was the establishment of the BRICS Network of Centres of Excellence (CoEs) on Mental Wellness, which will be coordinated by the National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS) in Bengaluru. The meeting also launched the BRICS Mission for Healthy Lifestyle and endorsed the BRICS Expert Working Group on Traditional Medicine.

quiz.question: Who resigned as the Union Minister of Education on July 25, 2026, amid student protests concerning alleged irregularities in competitive national examinations?
quiz.explanation: Shri Dharmendra Pradhan resigned as the Union Education Minister on July 25, 2026, following student protests linked to alleged irregularities and paper leaks in national competitive examinations. The resignation came amidst nationwide demands for accountability and exam reform. He had previously overseen several education and skill development policies under the Ministry of Education.

quiz.question: France became the first European Union nation to pass a nationwide ban on social media access for children under 15 years. According to this law, from which month and year will the ban on creating new accounts take effect?
quiz.explanation: France is the first EU country to introduce a nationwide ban on social media access for children under the age of 15. The law bars these children from creating new social media accounts starting September 2026, while access to existing accounts will be prohibited from January 2027. Social media companies will be legally responsible for implementing age-verification mechanisms under the new framework.

quiz.question: In July 2026, the United States imposed new Section 301 tariffs on 60 countries. India was placed in a lower additional tariff bracket of 10% instead of 12.5% following which policy change enacted by India's Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) in June 2026?
options: Prohibiting imports of goods manufactured using forced labour
Reducing customs duties on US-manufactured medical devices
Increasing subsidies for domestic semiconductor manufacturing
Exempting US agricultural products from non-tariff barriers
quiz.explanation: The United States imposed new Section 301 tariffs under the US Trade Act of 1974 on July 24, 2026. India was placed in the lower 10% tariff bracket rather than the proposed 12.5% after the DGFT amended the Foreign Trade Policy in June 2026 to prohibit imports of goods made using forced labour. This lower tariff bracket is shared with 16 other economies, while countries like China and South Korea face the higher 12.5% rate.
